listing.name: Super Mario 64 (Super Mario 64: Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Super Mario 64 recompilation separate from matching-decompilation ports. The project reports Bob-omb Battlefield through the King Bob-omb star and a return to the castle, rather than a complete campaign. Windows/Linux x86-64 packages and a WebGPU browser route are documented. Linux needs glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3 and FreeType. Use your own USA N64 ROM with SHA-1 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce. Further accepted revisions and BIOS/firmware needs are unconfirmed. You and the project manage setup and updates; Portcove has not qualified a release package or confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Keep the complete permitted Windows player
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted completed Windows copy of this specific implementation; the reviewed upstream route is v0.1.2. Keep SuperMario64Recompiled.exe, assets and all matching companions together. Finish any upstream source build outside Portcove. This is an existing-copy route, not managed package acquisition, source generation or a redistribution-rights grant.

steps.title: Keep the matching original
steps.instruction: At the separate Play step, use Load ROM and Start Game in the upstream launcher. Use your own Super Mario 64 USA, big-endian .z64; documented SHA-1 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce. The upstream player performs its own original check; Portcove registration does not import, normalize or authenticate the original.

warnings: Upstream reports Bob-omb Battlefield through King Bob-omb and return to the castle. Full-campaign, gameplay, physical controls and save compatibility are not established by this registration.
Use only software and original data you are permitted to use. Registration and owned-probe tests do not certify the upstream binary, full-game behavior or real save formats.
Keep the creating mode and actual locations; adding or removing the marker does not migrate existing data.
Edit settings only while the player is closed; registration does not move profiles or certify state compatibility between versions.

references.title: Keep the creating profile and portable mode
references.instruction: The reviewed Windows profile defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%/SuperMario64Recompiled. An existing portable.txt in the working folder selects that folder instead. Keep the creating mode and actual locations; adding or removing the marker does not migrate existing data. Keep the whole profile, its original/EEPROM data, all JSON settings, controller profiles, mods and generated hires_font data. Preserve the complete runtime folder and any custom or external paths too. Edit settings only while the player is closed; registration does not move profiles or certify state compatibility between versions.
